title: InfoScan uses hard-coded cryptographic keys and initialization-vector values in its… (CVE-2026-120255)
description: InfoScan contains a vulnerability where hard-coded cryptographic keys and initialization vectors are used in its database encryption. These values protect the MongoDB password stored in the Windows registry. Because the cryptographic material is embedded in the application, an attacker with access to both the encrypted registry value and the application code could potentially recover the database password.
